newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index eased 3.21 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index eased 3.21 pct in December.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange average index lost 3.21 percent month-on-month in December, bourse statistics published on Thursday showed.
In November the index had eased 0.9 percent month-on-month.
The average index for December was 588.21 with the highest point at 598.11 recorded on December 2 and the lowest at 570.64 on December 31.
Total volume traded was 74.45 million dinars, including 33.76 million dinars on the first market.
In November, volume was 45 million dinars, including 31 million dinars on the first market.

Most of the average prices eased, including Tunisie Leasing falling 33.25 percent, airliner Tunis Air 20.26 percent, beer and coca bottler SFBT 16.78 percent, retail stores Monoprix 11.6 percent, Air Liquide 15.69 percent and chemical firm Al-Kimia 7.11 percent.
Among winners were BIAT bank up 5.61 percent with 21,505 shares changing hands.
